subject: Multilingual Outreach for {company}
body:
Hi {name},

{personal_line}

I'm reaching out from Shabd AI (IIM-incubated; Top 30 at the India AI Impact Summit 2026).

We help organisations localise text, voice, and video across Indian languages and dialects, enabling them to reach more communities in the languages they actually speak.

For NGOs and social impact organisations, multilingual communication can significantly improve programme reach, beneficiary trust, and community participation, especially in rural and semi-urban contexts where English or formal Hindi creates real barriers to engagement.

We support with:
- Localisation of programme content, field materials, and training modules
- Multilingual beneficiary communication across WhatsApp, SMS, and in-person formats
- Translation of impact reports, proposals, and donor communication
- Regional language awareness campaigns and community outreach content
- Localisation of digital platforms and mobile applications for last-mile users

We currently support organisations including CRY, ARMMAN, Quest Alliance, and Central Square Foundation on exactly this.

Would it make sense to connect briefly on how {company} is thinking about language accessibility in your outreach?

Best,
{sender}
